result.reason: The test suite conforms to all three conventions. The top-level describe names the unit by module name ('apply-discount'), nested describes use 'when' clauses, and each it states one observable outcome reading as a sentence. Every it block contains exactly one expect, using toEqual/toMatchObject for compound shapes. Tests exercise only the public run function and observable returned values, build data fresh inside each test, and use no spies, mocks, or module-scope access.

The test file fully complies with all specification requirements: proper subject framing with module name and when clauses, one assertion per test block, and adherence to functionality-focused testing without implementation details.
